finalText:
Build clean, exit 0.

Found real bugs, not just dep-noise:
- `src/core/options.js` — bundler bump changed options shape (`retries` → `retryCount`), old code still read `options.retries`, threw on undefined. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`; strict check threw on that. Now treats `undefined` as `false` (disabled).

Rest (DEP0142/198/233/250/267, W1042/2213/3307, tree-shaking notes) is just noisy deprecation log from the bump — harmless, left alone. Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
